Arguments.Name: EmailName
Arguments.Tooltip: The email name used just for logging purposed. Given it with meaning purposed of the email.

Arguments.Name: OutlookAppPath
Arguments.Tooltip: Path location of outlook application to send email.

Arguments.Name: EmailTO
Arguments.Tooltip:
The email TO received. If there want  multiple TO received then make sure used ';'.

For example: abc@gmail.com; xyz@gmail.com;

Arguments.Name: EmailBodyMessage
Arguments.Tooltip: Body message of the email that want to be sended.

Arguments.Name: EmailCC
Arguments.Tooltip:
The email CC. If there is no CC in email just leave it with the default value '-'. If there want  multiple to CC then make sure used ';'.

For example: abc@gmail.com; xyz@gmail.com;

Arguments.Name: EmailAttachmentCollection
Arguments.Tooltip: List collection of files that want to be attached in send email.

Arguments.Name: MailAccount
Arguments.Tooltip: The outlook mail account used for sended an email.

Arguments.Name: TimeoutSendEmail
Arguments.Tooltip: The timeout in seconds of process send email. The default value is 30 seconds

Arguments.Name: ExceptionMessageSendEmail
Arguments.Tooltip: Exception message if send email is failed and thrown an exception.
